title: Rolling a Sum of Seven
problem: Roll two fair dice repeatedly until their sum is 7. What is the expected number of rounds, including the successful round?

hints.text: Each round restarts the same experiment if it fails.
Six of the 36 ordered dice outcomes sum to 7, so the waiting time is geometric.

solution.setup: A round succeeds with probability 6/36=1/6 independently of previous rounds.
solution.reasoning: Let E be the expected number of rounds. First-step analysis gives E=1+(5/6)E, hence E=6. Equivalently, a geometric waiting time with success probability p has mean 1/p.
solution.sanityCheck: A one-in-six event should take about six independent attempts on average.

keyInsight: Repeated independent rounds until a fixed event form a geometric waiting-time problem.
recognitionCues: Failure leaves the experiment in exactly its original state.
commonMistakes: Answering 7 because the target sum is 7.
followUps: Which target sum minimizes the expected waiting time?
